description: The sentence \(\exists v\forall u\,(u=v)\) holds exactly when the domain is nonempty and has at most one element, hence exactly when it is a singleton.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.commonEqual_realize.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] : M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.commonEqual L ↔ Subsingleton M ∧ Nonempty M
